refs.purpose: Output contract: one ref per workflow input, resolved or an honest gap with a reason. Cast bundles the JSON Schema; validate with `foundry validate-test-data-refs` before returning.
refs.verification: Run the test-data-resolution chain on a pinned scenario and confirm each leg's test-data-refs.json validates and implement-galaxy-workflow-test stages from it.

produces.description: Test data the paper names, one ref per workflow input (URLs, shapes, hashes). Shared id with [[find-test-data]], which fills only the inputs this Mold leaves unresolved.

consumes.description: Free-form summary from [[summarize-paper]]; sample data and reference evidence the test fixtures derive from.
Galaxy interface brief from [[workflow-brief-to-galaxy-interface]] pinning the workflow input labels, collection shapes, and datatypes each ref must map onto, in PAPER → GALAXY.
CWL design from [[freeform-summary-to-cwl-design]] naming the workflow input ports each ref must map onto, in PAPER → CWL.
